pages.text: A bronze powered rail storing 50,000 FE, for carts with the [[energy_upgrade]].

**Filling:** a [[heat_turbine|turbine]] or another mod's generator **right next to it** fills it by itself, up to 1,000 FE per tick.

**Charging:** it passes up to 1,000 FE per tick into an energy-upgraded cart on it.

**Station:** unpowered it holds carts still, so the locomotive stops and charges; power it to send the cart on.
